data.title: IDACORP, Inc. Increases Common Stock Dividend
data.description: IDACORP, Inc. revealed that its Board of Directors sanctioned a rise in the regular quarterly cash dividend on IDACORP’s common stock to $0.90 per share, amounting to an annual indicated dividend of $3.60 per share. The company has consistently increased dividends yearly since 2011, marking a total dividend growth of 200% and a compound annual growth rate of 7.6% since then. Such increment underscores the company's commitment to rewarding shareholders.

data.description: Recently, Latham & Watkins has boosted its esteemed Antitrust & Competition Practice in Europe by welcoming Victor Levy as a partner in its Paris office on September 18, 2026. This addition aims to fortify the firm's global platform and expertise in the field.

data.title: Lainey Wilson, Jelly Roll and Lukas Nelson Share Their Songs and Stories at All for the Hall Los Angeles with Special Guest John Mayer
data.description: A gala fundraiser concert in Los Angeles on September 18, 2026, was held to support education programs at the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum. Country artist Lainey Wilson expressed optimism for the event, stating, "It's gonna be a good night, I feel it in my bones." The concert, known as All for the Hall Los Angeles, aimed to raise funds for educational initiatives. Attendees were treated to performances and entertainment in support of this cause.

data.title: University of Phoenix study finds GenAI use among online adult learners associated with academic performance and technology confidence
data.description: New peer-reviewed research from the University of Phoenix challenges the assumption that students mainly utilize generative AI to compensate for academic challenges or time constraints. The study, published on Sept. 18, 2026, highlights a different perspective on the use of AI by students. The scholars at the University of Phoenix analyzed data and found that the prevailing belief may not accurately reflect the reasons behind students using generative AI. This research provides valuable insights into the motivations of students using AI in academia, with significant implications for understanding technology's role in education.

data.title: USA TrackBusway® Demonstrates Adaptable 225A Power in New T225 Installation Video
data.description: In Columbus, Ohio on September 18, 2026, USA TrackBusway® unveiled a new T225 installation video designed to guide engineers and electrical contractors in understanding how overhead power connections can be adjusted as equipment layouts evolve. The five-minute walkthrough demonstrates the adaptation process and aims to assist professionals in efficiently configuring power systems.

data.title: EPB Launches IonQ Forte Enterprise Quantum Computer in Chattanooga
data.description: Today, EPB in Chattanooga, Tennessee, announced the opening of the EPB Quantum Center, becoming the first commercial quantum computing and networking hub in America. This launch showcases the IonQ Forte Enterprise quantum computer, marking a significant milestone in the field. The center aims to facilitate advancements in quantum computing and has established itself as a pioneer in commercial quantum technology.

data.title: Teva Announces New Olanzapine LAI (TEV-'749) Post Hoc Data Highlighting High Rates of Stabilization and Long-Term Efficacy as Once-Monthly Subcutaneous Injectable for the Treatment of Schizophrenia in Adults
data.description: In Parsippany, New Jersey, on September 18, 2026, Teva Pharmaceuticals, a U.S. branch of Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd., disclosed new data regarding olanzapine LAI (TEV-'749) from the SOLARIS Phase 3 trial at the Psych Congress event in New Orleans, LA. The post hoc analysis showcased the effectiveness, safety, and durability of TEV-'749, a monthly subcutaneous long-acting injectable formulation of olanzapine for treating schizophrenia in adults. Key insights on treatment switch strategies were also provided, emphasizing the acute and long-term efficacy of TEV-'749. The event took place from September 15 to 19, 2026.
